positive_global_styles: instrumental cinematic horror score for a premium YouTube countdown of the scariest horror books
key of C minor, around 80 BPM unless stated otherwise
low cello drones, prepared piano, detuned music box, bowed metal textures, soft deep taiko-like hits, subtle sub bass
tense, eerie and atmospheric but elegant and premium, never cheesy
mix leaves plenty of space for a spoken voice-over in the mid range

positive_local_styles: cold open: a lonely detuned music box melody over a deep drone from the very first second
a slow heartbeat pulse in the low end
a dark swelling hit in the last two seconds
keeps playing at full energy until the very last second, no ending
